explanation: The value is 0 at every D1 and GO step and at nearly every D2; it fires only at D2 late in the episode (about trial 85 or later) when the agent chose a2 and reached S2 by the common transition, and the trial D1 showed the previous trial was unrewarded. In that case it is usually 8-10, drops to about 6-7 when the trial right before was also such an unrewarded a2-to-S2 trial, and stays 0 for the same pattern earlier in the episode, after a1 choices, after rare transitions, or when the previous trial was rewarded.
